scripts.clean:android-assets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const dir = 'android/app/src/main/assets/public'; const purge = ['Mydan.apk', 'Mydan-debug.apk', '_headers', '_redirects', 'landing.html', 'sitemap.xml', 'robots.txt']; purge.forEach(f => { const p = dir + '/' + f; if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.unlinkSync(p); }); console.log('Purged web/binary bloat from Android assets');"
scripts.cap:sync: vite build --mode android && cap sync android && npm run clean:android-assets
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release:win: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.apk:release:unix: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.aab:release:win: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.aab:release:unix: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
